statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
Continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is required
Shorter-term monitoring cannot reliably accomplish capturing potential arrhythmic events
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on CO-197, indicating required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained
